interfaces.title: Adapter plan quality summary for display
inputs: requirement folder path rdir containing PLAN.md and optionally PLAN.json
outputs: None when rdir/PLAN.json does not exist
{ok: true, summary: quality.analyze(plan)} for a structurally valid plan
{ok: false, errors: up to five strings} for unreadable or invalid PLAN.json or unexpected failure
invariants: never raises, never writes files, never spawns subprocesses
summary equals the JSON printed by plan-json report for the same PLAN.json
only the adapter imports the planner module
integration_criteria: Plan tab values match plan-json report output for the same real PLAN.json
Plan tab HTML is unchanged when the adapter returns None
